1.title: AI Cannot Invent Good Hypotheses | Greg Kamradt
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Greg Kamradt (ARC Prize Foundation President) discusses why OpenAI's Astra achieved 99% accuracy on ARC-AGI-3, what that saturation reveals about current LLM scaling limits, and what properties next-generation AI benchmarks need to avoid being gamed by memorization or hill-climbing.

1.title: AI Outperforms Junior Accountants on Real Work | Edward Hu
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Edward Hu (Mercor, ex-OpenAI) discusses how frontier model benchmarks fail in practice, why models outperform junior professionals on retrieval tasks while gaming evals, and Mercor's shift from data delivery to open-source model training and economic impact measurement.

1.title: AI Startups Locked Out of Compute in 6 Months | Evan Conrad
1.author: MTS
1.hook: SF Compute CEO Evan Conrad on the mechanics of the AI compute shortage — why startups face soaring prepayment requirements, how hardware risk concentrates like 2008 systemic risk, and what credit market evolution is needed. Includes SF Compute's forwards market approach.

1.title: I tested 4 AI agents on 9 real tasks. Here’s who won.
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Benchmark of 4 AI agents (Grok Bot, Dot, Muse, Claude Duet) across 9 real tasks—Slack drafts, video editing, bug fixing, Figma design, inbox triage, family newspaper, homework explanation, shoe shopping, video production. Scored live using computer use; includes final rankings and which agents the author actually trusts for work vs. life.

2.title: Robotics Is in Its 1973 Era | Evan Beard
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Standard Bots CEO on end-to-end learning enabling untrained workers to program industrial robots via vision models; positioning as 1973-computer inflection; claims on manufacturing cost reduction and supply chain reshoring.
